claims: As of April 13, 2026, hundreds of petrol stations in Ireland have run out of fuel.
Petrol stations in Ireland ran out of fuel following over a week of protests and blockades at refineries and depots.
Blockades at the Whitegate oil refinery and other depots have been cleared.
Major blockades were cleared by early April 13, 2026.
Over 600 filling stations were reported to have run dry.
Smaller slow-moving traffic convoys continued to disrupt main motorways including the M50.
The government has announced a €505 million support package.
The €505 million support package includes fuel price supports for farmers and hauliers.
The government has promised to keep critical services supplied.
Fuel shortages have forced some hauliers to reduce services.
The National Emergency Co-ordination Group warns of continued challenges especially in supply chains for farmers and fishers
